summary: SAC-246 is implemented and ready for human review. The saved candidate required no source changes during this verification pass. Fresh proof covers the empty shelf; save, read, reload, delete, and fresh-context persistence; both validation failures; literal markup rendering; and rejection of the 101st object. Raw D1/R2 read-back confirms 100 active snippets, 100 objects, one deletion tombstone, and no objects for rejected submissions. `npm ci`, formatting, type checking, all 16 tests, and the production build passed. The initial combined check had one transient Miniflare/workerd failure; the isolated test and full suite both passed on rerun. The first temporary-environment publication encountered Cloudflare 1042 and its immediate retry succeeded. The local unseeded preview visibly reports its storage-load error, while authoritative behavior proof comes from the fresh temporary Cloudflare environment. Claude’s prior proof gaps were addressed in one complete replacement collection. Implementation follows current Cloudflare documentation for [D1 prepared statements](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/worker-api/prepared-statements/), the [R2 Workers API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/api/workers/workers-api-reference/), and [static asset bindings](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/static-assets/binding/). Live release has not begun.
assumptions: The owner-requested repeat implementation stage was treated as verification of the completed OpenSpec candidate; completed tasks were not reopened when no source correction was required.
